text: １２ばん　どうろに　ポケモンが　ねてたろ？

structure.jp: ポケモンが　ねてたろ？

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: たろ is a rough, shortened way of saying ただろう, which asks the listener to agree: 'right?'. ねてたろ = 'was sleeping, right?'

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ねてた is the shortened spoken form of ねていた; ている shows something going on. ねてた = 'was sleeping'.
